claims: Cameron and Cayden Boozer are freshman basketball players for Duke University.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer are sons of former NBA All-Star Carlos Boozer.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer were born via IVF in 2007.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer were born to be genetic matches for their older brother Carmani.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer saved Carmani's life by providing stem cells to cure his sickle cell disease.
